newsitem.title: UK: HSBC, Stan Chart gain 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: HSBC, Stan Chart gain 3 pct.

text.p: Shares in HSBC Holdings Plc and Standard Chartered Plc rose on Wednesday, reflecting the latest sharp rise in Hong Kong shares and continued strong economic growth in China, dealers said.
"A growth rate of 9-1/2 percent in China should be awfully beneficial to HSBC and Standard," said one dealer.

HSBC shares were up 61-1/2p, or three percent, at 21.26 stg by 1121 GMT and Standard shares were up 34-1/2p or 3.5 percent at 10.13-1/2. Both outpaced the 1.3 percent gain in the FTSE 100 and the 1.9 percent rise in Hong Kong's Hang Seng index earlier today.
In Hong Kong, where half HSBC's shares are held, its stock rose HK$6.00 or 2.3 percent to HK$265.00.
Official Chinese figures showed the Chinese economy expanding by 9.5 percent in the first half of the year, similar to the growth rate through 1996, while inflation remained subdued.
